data.content: # Klopp Comments on Germany's Disappointing Start Under His Leadership. **Germany head coach Jürgen Klopp has addressed the team's performance in the 2026/27 Nations League following a draw with the Netherlands (1-1) and a loss to Greece (0-1).**. “Even before arriving here, I knew that German football is going through a tough time and that Jürgen Klopp wouldn’t be able to come in and solve all the problems with a wave of his hand. If anyone was unaware of that, they know now,” Klopp's words were relayed by the Bayern & Germany social media account. According to him, there will come a time in the near future when it will be difficult for any opponent to play against the Germany national team. In their next match, the team will host Serbia at home. The game is scheduled for October 1 at 21:45 Moscow time. Following that, Germany will face Greece away on October 4 at 21:45.
